title: Longest Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string containing just the characters '(' and ')', return the length of the longest valid (well-formed) parentheses substring.
input_format: A single line containing the parentheses string.
output_format: Print the maximum length of valid parentheses substring.

sample_tests.explanation: The longest valid parentheses substring is '()' of length 2.
The longest valid parentheses substring is '()()' of length 4.
The longest valid is '()(())' of length 6.
The whole string '((()))' is valid of length 6.
